history.text: Write a highly detailed, descriptive prompt of this image in English for an AI text-to-image generator (such as Midjourney, DALL-E, or Stable Diffusion). Describe the objects, background, style, lighting, color palette, and mood in detail. Do NOT include any introductory or concluding conversational text. Do not say 'Here is the prompt' or similar. Output ONLY the raw description of the image.

A young man with curly black hair and a mustache is taking a selfie in a bathroom. He is wearing a white t-shirt with a large pink and green camouflage pattern on the front that appears to spell out "GM". He has a silver watch on his left wrist. The background is tiled with white subway tiles. To the left of the man is a white soap dispenser. A metal grab bar is visible on the wall behind him. The lighting is bright, with the phone's flash creating a strong glare. The overall mood is casual and selfie-like. The color palette is dominated by white, gray, and the pink and green of the shirt's design.
